deterministic_skeleton: Underground pressure removes rooted membership by an exact local exponential survival law.
That immediate event is separated from already-fielded force and organization capital.
Recruitment propensity factors exactly into rate x eligible stock x mean mobilization/access intensity.
Realized fighter regeneration converts capital into the required supply reserve under an exact accounting identity.
Lower-experience replacement flow dilutes formation experience by an exact weighted-memory law.
At uncapped matched contact, experience-induced capability changes map to loss exchange through exact power elasticities.
stochastic_layer: Recruitment realization is a finite-subcohort binomial sampling process conditional on the frozen hazard state.
Organization stochastic collapse is a continuous-hazard Bernoulli event conditional on the frozen organization state, with deterministic capital/cohesion/rooted-force gates overriding the draw.
structural_theory.emergent_phase_result: The fresh 24-seed mobilization frontier shows how these laws combine into a leverage/ruin regime: additional recruitment initially grows rooted and fielded stock while consuming runway, then capital-triggered collapse rises sharply as cumulative burn approaches available resources.

verification.refactor_role: Existing formulas were factored into tested helpers; equivalence and RNG-continuation tests guard against semantic drift.

claim_boundary: These are mathematical and stochastic laws of the implemented Pineland model. Their coefficients and resulting synthetic phase boundaries are not empirical laws of real insurgency.
